name: person
label: Person
use: A human who uses or operates the system: the user, an operator.

name: system
label: Software system
use: The whole system being designed, shown as one box at the context level.

name: external
label: External system
use: A software system outside the team's control: a vendor API, another team's service.

name: component
label: Component
use: A part inside one container, such as a module or a package; used at the component level.

name: page
label: Web app
use: Something a person looks at in a browser or on a screen: a web page, a dashboard.

name: service
label: Server-side app
use: Running code that serves requests or runs a CLI: a server, an API, a daemon.

name: job
label: Function
use: Code that runs on a trigger or a timer, not as a long-running server.

name: store
label: Database
use: Durable structured data: a database, a folder of records.

name: file
label: File
use: Documents or files read and written whole: specs, configs, uploads.

name: files
label: File store
use: A collection of files read or written as whole documents.

name: queue
label: Queue
use: Messages or events passed in order. C4 shows these either as a container or as the label on an arrow.

name: agent
label: Agent
use: An AI agent that acts in a loop with tools: a coordinator, a builder.

name: model
label: Model
use: A language or ML model the system calls for one answer, such as an LLM judge. An agent acts in a loop with tools; a model does not.

name: compute
label: Compute instance
use: A virtual machine or bare server the team runs code on.

name: cluster
label: Container cluster
use: A cluster that schedules containers, such as Kubernetes.

name: balancer
label: Load balancer
use: Spreads incoming requests over several instances.

name: gateway
label: API gateway
use: The front door for API calls: routing, auth, rate limits.

name: cdn
label: CDN
use: Copies of static content served close to users.

name: cache
label: Cache
use: A fast, managed copy of data kept elsewhere, safe to lose.

name: dns
label: DNS
use: Maps names to addresses.

name: identity
label: Identity / auth
use: Who users and services are, and what they may do.

name: secrets
label: Secrets / keys
use: Stores and serves keys, tokens and passwords.

name: network
label: Network boundary
use: A private network or subnet that boxes sit inside.

name: firewall
label: Firewall / WAF
use: Filters traffic coming into a network or an app.

name: monitoring
label: Monitoring / logs
use: Collects metrics, logs and traces, and raises alerts.
